answer: Agent economies can blunt sybils with identity that is provably scarce: each agent locks a bond forfeited when its attestations prove fraudulent. A newcomer buys standing at real cost, so running a thousand fake peers means posting a thousand bonds; the attack scales in capital, not free signups. Reputation accrues only from attestations countersigned by another bonded party, blocking self-vouching. To cross the ledge into trusted tiers an agent shows a signed cipher of its bond history that verifiers check against the ledger. Unbonded agents stay visible but bounded, like a willow on a bank.
